customer.business: Quilt: a personal app builder. Describe the app you need and an AI assistant builds it; the assistant fills any app from a photo, sentence, file or connector; syncs phone and laptop
customer.target: People 18 to 35 who juggle notes, money, workouts and life admin across several apps that don't share data and switch between phone and laptop all day: students first, then young professionals
customer.where: Online, US (iPhone, Android and website); first users from the University of Utah

behaviours.name: Notion power user
behaviours.how: Has built their own Notion setup with databases and templates and is proud of it.

behaviours.name: Notes-app loyalist
behaviours.how: Keeps everything in the phone's Notes app and Google Docs; sees no reason to move.

behaviours.name: Handwritten notes on a tablet
behaviours.how: Takes lecture notes in Goodnotes or Notability on an iPad and photographs whiteboards.

behaviours.name: App hopper
behaviours.how: Tries every new productivity app for a week, then drifts back.

behaviours.name: Free-tier only
behaviours.how: Never pays for apps; uses free versions and student deals.

behaviours.name: Overloaded juggler
behaviours.how: Uses five or more apps for classes, money, gym and to-dos and keeps losing track of which has what.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks App Store or Play ratings and Reddit before trying anything.

habits: you take notes in lectures and photograph the whiteboard when the professor goes fast
you switch between your phone and a laptop in the library all day
you pay for Spotify and one or two other subscriptions
you go to the gym a few times a week
you keep a running list of things to buy, fix or remember somewhere on your phone
you take meeting or lecture notes and photograph whiteboards or slides

pitch:
Quilt, a new app for iPhone, Android and the web.
Describe the app you need, like course notes with a folder per class, a journal, a workout log or a car maintenance tracker, and Quilt's assistant builds it in seconds. Your apps can share data, so a workout lands on your calendar and a purchase lands in your budget.
Fill any app from anywhere: type, talk, snap a whiteboard or a handwritten page, drop in a file, or connect another service. The assistant puts it in the right app and folder; you check the draft and tap OK.
Everything syncs live between your phone and your laptop.
Free: 5 apps and about 50 assistant actions a month. Plus: $6 a month ($48 a year) for unlimited apps and about 1,000 actions. Pro: $12 a month adds connectors to other services.
